title: Restriction and descent of complete local sections
statement: For the complete-element predicate [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-complete-element] on a small ringed site, membership is preserved under every restriction V to U and descends along every covering sieve on U. The assertion holds for an arbitrary unbounded derived object K.

proof.text: Conversely take cohomology. A cohomology sheaf restricting to zero on the covering sieve has all sections zero: restrict on each object along the pulled-back covering sieve and apply sheaf separatedness. Thus all cohomology vanishes and the derived object is zero, including an empty covering sieve.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSite_completeElements_locality
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).over U))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)))
    : (∀ (U V : C) (a : V ⟶ U) (f : R.obj.obj (op U)),
        IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U f →
          IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K V (R.obj.map a.op f)) ∧
      (∀ (U : C) (S : Sieve U), S ∈ J U → ∀ f : R.obj.obj (op U),
        (∀ (V : C) (a : V ⟶ U), S a →
          IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K V (R.obj.map a.op f)) →
        IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U f)
